title: Towards Effective Discrimination Testing for Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in synthetic resumes using names associated with White, Black, Asian, and Hispanic groups to measure disparities in LLM-generated summary quality, sentiment, and simulated interview selection rates.
Automated red teaming using language models to generate adversarial and hostile questions targeting 'women', measuring the toxicity (Attack Success Rate) of the candidate models' responses.

Appending adversarial red teaming questions targeting 'homosexual' people to multi-turn domain-specific conversations (education and health) to evaluate if models exhibit toxic behavior in complex interaction modes.

Prompting a text-to-image diffusion model for photos of women from different racial and ethnic groups (White, Black, Asian, Latina) across varying guidance scales, and measuring the sexualization of the outputs using an NSFW classifier.
